patient.living_situation: Rents a room; separated from his partner
patient.employment_status: Unemployed since early 2024; previously a construction laborer
patient.social_context: Sees his young daughter at weekends; his sister lives nearby; some former friends still use
patient.background: Fictional former construction laborer, separated, who sees his young daughter at weekends.
patient.history_summary: Stimulant (methamphetamine) use in multi-day episodes since 2019, with a return to use in 2022 after a period without use.
patient.treatment_summary: Residential program in 2022 (completed); outpatient counseling in 2024 (left early); counseling again every two weeks since late 2025.

history_events.description: Starts using stimulants after a co-worker offers them.
Multi-day episodes with very little sleep become common; his sister notices weight loss.
Completes the residential program and begins a period without use.
Returns to use after a dispute about time with his daughter.
Returns to counseling with a new counselor.

factors.description: Long unstructured days without a job.
Contact with former friends who still use.
Conflict about time with his daughter.
Regular weekend time with his daughter; support from his sister.
Goes for days with very little sleep during heavy periods.

interventions.reported_outcome: Completed the program; returned to use about four months later.
Meets his counselor every two weeks.

progress.note: Using in multi-day episodes; intake interview completed.
Attending counseling every two weeks; reports fewer episodes.
